sloka: तत्र तां रजनीमुष्य केशिन्यां रघुनन्दनः ।प्रभाते पुनरुत्थाय लक्ष्मणः प्रययौ तदा ।। ७.५२.१ ॥
transliteration: tatra tāṁ rajanīmuṣya keśinyāṁ raghunandanaḥ ।prabhāte punarutthāya lakṣmaṇaḥ prayayau tadā ।। 7.52.1 ॥

translations.english: Having stayed that night in Keshini, Lakshmana, the delight of the Raghus, rose again in the morning and then departed.
